anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After moves f1 and f2 to holds: the first menu now states in prose that the merge-base sync is a mechanical repair needing no author decision (Before never said this), and the second menu puts merge on row 1 recommended instead of approve, which Before got wrong by demoting merge to row 2 for a non-author viewer. f3, f4 and f5 stay intact because After still offers merge with nothing pending described as blocking, keeps one recommended row with stop last, and says the checks on the updated branch pass. Two things to tighten so the replay stays as auditable as Before: After drops the `show evidence` record entirely, even though the prompt says to keep raw record updates and exact-head evidence there, and its second-turn prose never names the new head (b7d0a91) or run 7101, so a reader cannot confirm the evidence is exact-head rather than carried over; add a short `show evidence` section under each turn listing run id, head, the green required checks, lint skipped-inert, crew-approval pending-not-binding, and the sync/round accounting, while keeping the menu text itself in plain prose. Also consider phrasing the final verdict as 'required checks passed on b7d0a91' so the exact-head claim is visible without raw field labels.
